subject.title: [Bug] Silent fail-open when Tailscale interface binding fails on gateway start

question: Should an explicit `gateway.bind: "tailnet"` abort gateway startup when no usable Tailscale IPv4 exists, or preserve the shipped loopback fallback?
rationale: The documented explicit bind meaning and custom-bind precedent favor failing closed, but current tests intentionally preserve local availability and existing users may depend on that recovery path.

options.title: Fail Explicit Tailnet Startup
options.body: Reject startup with an actionable error when no Tailscale IPv4 is available, matching the explicit bind contract and custom-bind behavior.

options.title: Preserve Fallback With Warning
options.body: Keep loopback availability but emit a prominent startup warning that the configured tailnet endpoint was not established.

recommendation.title: Fail Explicit Tailnet Startup
recommendation.body: Reject startup with an actionable error when no Tailscale IPv4 is available, matching the explicit bind contract and custom-bind behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The issue timeline explicitly routes and subscribes this person to the compatibility-sensitive gateway product choice.
